svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Tracked objects in low Earth orbit, by type
Objects are subtracted from the time series after they have reentered the Earth's atmosphere. Not all objects
are tracked: in 2021, the European Space Agency estimated there were more than 130 million space debris

tspan.tspan: Low Earth orbit is defined by a point of closest approach to Earth below 2,000 kilometers. Debris are assigned to the launch date of the

text.tspan: original object from which they were separated.
